# Linear adds mobile diffs


By OpenTools Team


·


November 6, 2026


Missing code and missing comments need different checks.


Linear[introduced Mobile Diffs](https://linear.app/now/mobile-diffs) on November 5 for iOS and Android. Viewed‑file progress crosses devices; review threads and preview links are available in the latest apps.


##


Missing diff


A visible PR does not prove code access.[Linear](https://linear.app/docs/diffs) requires selected‑repository access for its GitHub integration plus your personal GitHub connection. Ask the GitHub organization owner to check installation permissions; IP allow lists also apply.


##


Missing feedback


[GitHub](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/how-tos/review-pull-requests/reviewing-proposed-changes-in-a-pull-request) keeps pending line comments private until review submission.[Linear](https://linear.app/docs/diffs) excludes unfinished GitHub reviews from sync; submitted review state does sync.


Use viewed markers to resume reading, then check submission. If GitHub shows the review was submitted but a comment is absent in Linear, inspect its GitHub thread: documented API limits exclude some inline details. Missing feedback therefore calls for a submission‑and‑thread check before changing repository access.
